blog.heading: Music, parties and planning
blog.description: Music and event planning advice from Wassim, DJ Wasabi. Explore his articles, from choosing your first dance song to planning your celebration.
blog.intro: I'm Wassim. These are a few things I'd talk through with you when we're planning your music.
blog.socialAlt: DJ Wasabi blog: music, parties and planning, with Wassim

articles.title: How do you help people relax at a work party?
articles.description: Planning a staff dinner or work party? Wassim shares practical advice on music, MC introductions and helping colleagues join in at their own pace.
articles.summary: If you're worried the team will stay a little guarded, I'd start with how well they know each other and what would help them feel comfortable.

next.title: Planning a work party?
next.text: Tell me who's coming and what you're hoping the evening will feel like. We can talk through the music and any MC hosting you'd like.

articles.title: Should we hire a wedding MC or ask a friend?
articles.description: Should you hire a professional wedding MC or ask a friend? Weigh the cost, their enjoyment of the day and what would help you both relax.
articles.summary: I'd think about who you would both feel comfortable having on the microphone, and what the job would ask of them.

articles.title: Should I give my DJ a playlist?
articles.description: Wondering how to make different music tastes work at your party? Wassim explains what to send your DJ and how to discuss favourites and requests.
articles.summary: You want your guests to enjoy the music. That doesn't mean you need to choose every song for the night.

next.title: Planning a party?

articles.title: How do we choose music for a multicultural wedding?
articles.description: Planning music for a multicultural wedding? Wassim discusses dabke, Greek dances, family requests and coordinating entrances with your DJ and MC.
articles.summary: I'd start with the traditions that matter to each of you, then plan how they fit alongside the music you both love.

articles.title: What should we check with our venue before booking a DJ?
articles.description: Booking a wedding or party venue in Sydney? Wassim shares the questions to ask about music finish times, sound limiters, access, power and outdoor areas before you sign.
articles.summary: Before you sign, I'd ask the venue when the music stops, when everyone leaves, where the DJ would set up and what happens if it rains.

image.alt: DJ Wasabi at his DJ booth with speakers and event lighting
image.caption: A complete setup at an event. More from

articles.socialAlt: DJ Wasabi: what should we check with our venue before booking a DJ?

next.title: Found your venue?
next.text: Tell me what they said about finish times, sound and set-up, even if some answers are still coming. We can plan the music around your room.
next.contactLabel: Talk to me about your wedding

articles.title: Can we have a DJ at a party at home?
articles.description: Planning an 18th, 21st or milestone party at home in Sydney? Wassim talks through neighbours, finish times, the NSW hours for music at home, layout and weather.
articles.summary: Yes, and I'd start with your neighbours and your finish time. Then we can work back to the music and the layout.

articles.title: How do we plan the music for our ceremony?
articles.description: Planning your wedding ceremony music? Wassim talks through guests arriving, timing the walk in, the signing, walking out and checking everyone can hear.
articles.summary: Four moments to talk through: your guests arriving, walking in, signing, and walking out. Songs can come later.
